'''Pieralos''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]] that served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]], one of the two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pierlos was mentioned in the [[2010]] roleplaying game sourcebook ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
